title: Streaming Response Reader
body: The streaming response content tool is StreamReader. It handles streaming response content by reading chunks from a response buffer.

title: Streaming Trace Logger
body: The streaming trace logger records response content for diagnostics. It is a logging utility, not the tool that handles streaming response content.

title: Accessibility Workshop City
body: The accessibility workshop was hosted in Berlin. The city appears in the final event note and is the intended answer.

title: Accessibility Planning Memo
body: The accessibility planning memo mentions Boston as a candidate city for the workshop, but it was not the hosted location.

title: LRU Cache Policy
body: The cache policy that evicts least-recently-used entries is LRU. LRU updates recency when entries are accessed.

title: LRI Cache Policy
body: The LRI cache policy evicts least-recently-inserted entries. It tracks insertion order rather than recent use.

title: Markdown Reset Reuse Note
body: The document says reset must be called before reuse. Markdown parsers keep references between conversions unless reset is called.

title: Markdown Build Parser Note
body: The document says build_parser constructs processors for reuse. It is about parser construction, not the reset call before reuse.

title: Session Memory Alpha Evidence
body: Session memory can boost alpha evidence after preview. The marked answer for the alpha memory question is Alpha Memory.

title: Session Memory Beta Evidence
body: Session memory can preserve beta evidence after retrieval. The marked answer for the alpha memory question is Beta Memory.
